h1_patch_vs_rewrite.hypothesis: CLAN patch path cuts output tokens >=50% vs ad-hoc editing at equal fidelity
h1_patch_vs_rewrite.verdict: CONFIRMED on marginal authoring vs BEST-CASE splicing ad-hoc; promote to HEAVY
h1_patch_vs_rewrite.fidelity: 8/8 both arms, 0 meaningful unintended diffs (CLAN: 1 cosmetic whitespace in SVG)
h1_patch_vs_rewrite.note: win concentrates in data-bound fields - one patch updates data+view while ad-hoc edits two files, often duplicating supplied text. Tested against best-case SPLICING ad-hoc; vs full-rewrite ad-hoc the gap would be far larger.

h2_long_chain_crossover.hypothesis: CLAN distilled re-injection grows sub-linearly and crosses below ad-hoc by hop 6-10
h2_long_chain_crossover.verdict: NOT CONFIRMED in LITE - no genuine crossover; CLAN stayed 1.5-2.3x ABOVE ad-hoc for hops 1-9
h2_long_chain_crossover.apparent_crossover_hop10: artifact - ad-hoc lead-partner authored a full report.html, ballooning its snapshot; not a real injected-context crossover
h2_long_chain_crossover.note: at small structured-findings scale CLAN is net injected-context overhead, not savings (matches research/14). CLAN re-injects the growing decision chain every hop. Crossover needs larger per-hop payloads and/or chain pruning - flagged for HEAVY promotion with bigger documents.

methodology_caveats: n=1 directional only - no variance claims
H1 ad-hoc arm spliced surgically (best case); supplied content (residency fragment, exec summary) excluded from marginal output
H2-adhoc error counts inflated by a harness artifact (Write-tool report-file guard blocked .md fragments) - NOT a CLAN finding
guide overhead (~7.9k chars) dominates cold injection - reinforces the v1.2 guide-shrink lever

findings: F1 patch-data auto-appends 'unknown-agent / processed document' chain noise
F2 stale-view hint suggests clan render even for hand-authored full-html views (destructive)
F3 patch-data rejects UTF-8 BOM (PowerShell 5.1 Out-File default) with an unhelpful error
F4 viewer edit bridge persists instrumentation attrs and saves no-op patches
F5 full-html repack drops human/patches.yaml - fold superseded human patches into the decision chain
F6 prose keys (assumptions) collide across branches - default append policy or role prefixes
F7 fork copies parent context.md verbatim - branch agents see conflicting task instructions
F8 requirements.yaml (layer 5) unused - needs first-class commands
F9 create bootstraps a {type: object} stub schema - no field guidance, patch-schema never triggers naturally
F10 full-html replacement drops parent human/assets - auto-carry referenced assets or hint --assets
F11 pack-html frontmatter merge-patches data.yaml but docs never say so - agents re-transcribe prior data verbatim
F12 agents guess 'clan read decisions' - add as alias of read chain
F13 stale-view hint fires on data-bound fields even after patch-data updated the bound view - pushed pack-html/render needlessly on 4 H1 hops (cousin of F2)
F14 patch-data RFC-7396 array-replace forces re-authoring the whole array to append one item - the ONLY place CLAN lost output in H1 (582 vs 346 chars, 1.7x); needs an append affordance or doc
F15 patch-data has no inline JSON (--set / inline arg); requires a file or stdin '-' - caused recurring first-try errors across H1 CLAN hops 3,4,7
F16 no 'clan read-html' subcommand - agents used 'clan read human' to locate selectors for patch-html
